units.source_text: 将近破晓，佛堂里朗诵“法华忏法”[\[13\]](#part1334.html#m13)的声音，和山风的吼声相呼应，倍觉庄严。

en.t: Near daybreak, the voices in the Buddha hall chanting the Lotus Repentance rite answered the roar of the mountain wind, making the scene feel all the more solemn.
Mingled with them was also the sound of a waterfall.
